clues.text: Jesus, His mother and His disciples were all at a wedding held in this town in Galilee.
At a wedding in this town, Jesus' mother told Him, "They have no more wine."
At a wedding feast in this town, Jesus told His mother that His hour had not yet come.
In this town, a master of the banquet told a bridegroom he had saved the fine wine until now.
In this Galilean town Jesus performed the first of His signs, and His disciples believed in Him.
In this town, a royal official begged Jesus to come down and heal his dying son in Capernaum.
Nathanael, who went fishing with Simon Peter on the Sea of Tiberias, came from this town.
